prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a rear-end collision claim. Injury: neck and back strain. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1212; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim received by phone from the insured driver following a rear-end collision at a signalized intersection. Insured reports stopping for traffic when struck from behind by a vehicle that did not stop in time. Police report requested. No injuries reported at the scene by either party, but claimant mentioned stiffness in the neck later in the call.

Entry 2: Recorded statement taken from the claimant. Reports neck pain and lower back soreness beginning the morning after the collision. Denies prior claims involving the neck or back. Claimant has not yet seen a physician and was advised to seek medical evaluation and keep records of all treatment and expenses. Claimant is not represented by an attorney at this time.

Entry 3: Reviewed photos submitted by the claimant showing rear bumper damage to the insured vehicle and minor crush damage to the trunk area. Repair estimate received from the body shop of the claimant's choice. Vehicle is drivable but claimant reports difficulty turning the head to the left. Advised claimant that a medical authorization form will be needed before records can be requested from the treating provider.

Entry 4: Claimant visited an urgent care clinic and was diagnosed with cervical strain and lumbar strain. Treatment plan includes muscle relaxants, a course of physical therapy, and rest from heavy lifting for several weeks. Medical records received and logged. Claimant confirmed no lawyer has been retained and asked general questions about how the claim process works, which were answered in plain terms without giving legal advice.

Entry 5: Follow-up call with claimant to check on symptoms. Reports neck and back pain are improving slowly but still present with prolonged sitting. Physical therapy evaluation scheduled. File remains open pending completion of treatment and receipt of final bills. Reserve reviewed and will be revisited after the next medical update.
